item.text:
Related products now sit behind a Suspense boundary and use request-time caching, so the default product-page prefetch contains the loading state. The [featured-product link](/workspace/app/page.tsx:7) uses `prefetch={true}` to fetch the complete page before navigation.

I verified this with Next 16.4.5: the build passed, the product page’s static prefetch contained no related-product names, and the full route response contained both products. The existing local [package.json](/workspace/package.json) edit specifies Next 15, whose stable release rejects this project’s Cache Components config; I left that edit untouched.
